segments.name: Mining projects
segments.description: Develops the Matawinie Mine and Uatnan Mining Project in Québec, Canada.
segments.evidence: The Company currently operates in two segments: the Mining projects (which includes the Matawinie Mine project and the Uatnan Mining Project) and the Battery Material Plant project.

segments.name: Battery Material Plant project
segments.description: Develops the Battery Material Plant project in Québec, Canada, for carbon-neutral advanced graphite materials.
segments.evidence: The Mining projects and Battery Material Plant project were identified as separate segments due to their specific nature.
